records.body: Does the API support pagination for the accounts endpoint, or do we need to fetch everything at once?

records.subject: Re: API pagination
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for reaching out. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg
